name: Synchronise sound to visible action
short_description: Synchronise sound to visible action once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can synchronise sound to visible action in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Synchronise sound to visible action means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Synchronise sound to visible action in a fresh real-life scenario.
